access_evidence: SOURCE_PROBES/patents: sitemap index 200/360906 B; weekly gzip sitemap 200/238148 B; document.html 200/124905 B; document.pdf 200/524450 B. Live collection of 228 records over 241 requests / 30.7 MB.
historical_depth: EP publications from 1978-12-20 to present (weekly since 1978-12-20)
licence_note: Official public patent publications. The EPO terms of use apply; no explicit reuse licence is stated for the publication servers. We therefore keep derived bibliographic records plus bounded hashed samples rather than a mirror, and record this as open_no_explicit_licence rather than claiming CC-style rights.
machine_interface: gzip XML sitemap index -> weekly sitemap -> HTML/PDF document
name: EPO European Publication Server (sitemap + INID front pages)
notes: INID 43 = application publication date, INID 45 = grant publication date. The connector selects by kind; using 43 for a B grant would misdate it by years.
rate_policy: no published limit; EPO asks indexers to register; we self-limit to ~1.5 req/s and a fixed budget
robots_summary: Advertises /publication-server/sitemap.xml and /gpi/sitemap.xml; disallows /pise-server/, /qual_lod/ and /linked-data/{id,doc,data,def,representation}/. Asks crawler operators to e-mail patentinformation@epo.org to register for deep redirects when building indexes. This connector samples and does not index.
unlock_route: None needed for bounded research use. For index-scale harvesting, register with patentinformation@epo.org as the robots.txt asks.
what_is_new: The only keyless channel found that yields applicant-of-record, inventor, IPC, CPC, filing date, publication date, priority and abstract for real EP patents. This is the first working patent acquisition asset for MedRadar.
